nodes.summary: Offline osu! timing workbench: analysis, map tools and distribution. Hitsounds, trainer, Songs browser and compilation are parked on parked/desktop-extras (W1).

nodes.summary: Major app capabilities currently present.

nodes.summary: Validation, alignment, reference timing, snap audit, assisted timing, structure and exports.

nodes.label: [PARKED] Hitsounds H1–H5
nodes.summary: H1–H5 shipped. H7 audio-only proposal shipped without an accuracy claim; H6 sample recommendation, instrument lanes and mismatch rule remain gated after measured review. Parked on parked/desktop-extras and the tag v3-desktop-full in W1 (2026-10-26): the project's core is timing.

nodes.summary: SQLite/FTS5 index, scan/search and health check. Precision labels still need R6 verdicts. The index stays for the measurement server; its app page is parked on parked/desktop-extras (W1, 2026-10-26).

nodes.label: [PARKED] Train section and trainer gate
nodes.summary: Practice copies, rate ladders, mod feel, undo/cleanup; gate green. Parked on parked/desktop-extras and the tag v3-desktop-full in W1 (2026-10-26): the project's core is timing.

nodes.label: [PARKED] Compile section + map builder
nodes.summary: Usable in app; Phase 25 rows 25.1–25.19 are implemented, including loudness match, junction placement, phrase selection, order suggestion and reference grading. Tempo-matched junction 25.20 remains unlikely; crossfade and .osb background were rejected. Parked on parked/desktop-extras and the tag v3-desktop-full in W1 (2026-10-26): the project's core is timing.

nodes.label: [SHIPPED] MSI + portable ZIP
nodes.summary: v0.1.0-alpha published with SBOM, checksums and notices; associations/setup delivered. Unsigned by owner decision.

nodes.label: 0.3.0 REQUIRED ROWS
nodes.summary: Required rows must be resolved and release checklist rerun.

nodes.label: [OPEN · BLOCKER] R6 library precision sample
nodes.summary: Sample/sheet drawn 2026-10-06; verdicts owed. Meet 15/25 bar or rename actionable/weak labels.

nodes.label: [CLOSED BY MEASUREMENT] T6 section labels from repetition
nodes.summary: Closed for 0.3.0 without shipping labels. Four approaches/splits failed the +15-point requirement; fresh seed-61 baseline scored +11.5 tune (16 maps) and +14.3 held-out (10). Keep the Kiai card refusing; any future signal needs a fresh untouched confirmation split.

nodes.label: [CLOSED BY MEASUREMENT] T7 H6/H7 disposition
nodes.summary: H7 app surface shipped 2026-10-07 but measured clap F1 0.29 vs 0.59 baseline on 6 songs. H6 sample-role recommendation remains withheld after one-shot misclassification. Fresh Rust evidence: median P(snare)+P(clap) 0.194 over 2,859 matched claps from 9 accessible songs; 3 access-denied skips. Keep lanes, mismatch rule and sample recommendations gated; no accuracy claim.

nodes.label: LONGER-TERM · OUTSIDE 0.3.0
nodes.summary: Roadmap work beyond current release blockers.

nodes.label: [RESEARCH] Phase 10 real-audio accuracy → 1.0.0
nodes.summary: Corpus B research, not 0.3.0. Fingerprint/reuse, neural beats, ensemble and alignment research remain; figures vary by dated source and are not freshly measured here.

nodes.label: [DEFERRED] Phase 24 other-language gates
nodes.summary: TypeScript needs Node.js, not installed/requested; .NET SDK present.

nodes.label: [DEFERRED] Phase 25 tempo-matched junction
nodes.summary: Rows 25.1–25.19 are complete. 25.20 remains unlikely after a measured 23–24 ms attack shift from phase-vocoder stretching; crossfade and .osb background are rejected.

nodes.label: [POLICY] No networked services
nodes.summary: No network calls, telemetry, external APIs or update checks.

nodes.label: [UNDECIDED] Export convention vs sound onset
nodes.summary: Choose whether export follows ranked-map timing (about -21 ms) or sound onset; state convention in claims.
